text.name: India-US Nuclear Deal
text.rules: Record "new partner". LIO spends 2 points on one action. SAE chooses: Court India too? If yes, SAE spends 1 point on actions, then until the end of this turn, each time SAE spends points, it spends 1 fewer, never below 1; if no, LIO spends 1 point on actions. Lower Escalation by 1.
text.history: The United States and India announced a civil nuclear cooperation initiative on 18 July 2005; the Nuclear Suppliers Group granted India a waiver on 6 September 2008 and the bilateral "123 Agreement" was signed on 10 October 2008.
